summary: I expanded my port-question notes to cover the dispatcher-owned clock (external dispatcher arms monolith-wake steps with exponential backoff rather than a prompt re-broadcast loop) and the responder/monolith split (single-call low-latency chat reply vs deep agentic monolith). I also read the mem skill and confirmed my kernel exposes only a deliberate minimal subset of the shipped skills, leaving passive retrieval disabled by design and otherwise staying idle on spontaneous timer wakes.
